title: Anheuser-Busch Invests $1.5 Million in Cutwater's San Diego Production Facility, Expanding Innovation and Production Capabilities
summary: New investment will expand production capacity, create manufacturing jobs and support continued growth of America's #1 spirits-based cocktail brand
body_markdown:
**About Anheuser-Busch**


At Anheuser-Busch, our purpose is to create a future with more cheers. For more than 165 years as a leading American manufacturer, we have delivered a legacy of brewing great-tasting, high-quality beers that have satisfied beer drinkers for generations. As the nation’s top brewer, one of the fastest growing spirits companies, and an insurgent force in energy drinks, we drive economic prosperity nationwide through investments in our people, facilities, and communities. We are the only alcohol company that invests in the U.S. at this scale.


We are home to the nation’s most iconic beers, ready-to-drink spirits and beyond beer brands, including Michelob ULTRA – America’s #1 top-selling and fastest-growing beer – Busch Light, Budweiser, Bud Light, Stella Artois, Cutwater Spirits, NÜTRL Vodka Seltzer, industry-leading craft beers and non-alcohol beers like Michelob ULTRA Zero. We are guided by our commitment to the communities we call home and to the 65,000 hardworking Americans who bring our products to life. That’s who we are. For more information, visit[www.anheuser-busch.com](https://url.uk.m.mimecastprotect.com/s/Z5EWCO8DlsGAJn0xhEfPIG3nk5?domain=anheuser-busch.com) or follow Anheuser-Busch on[LinkedIn](https://url.uk.m.mimecastprotect.com/s/YwlSCPQEmHl4OWoXC0hjIxQ9Gj?domain=linkedin.com) ,[X](https://url.uk.m.mimecastprotect.com/s/r0NNCQ7GJhx68O3PCMi5IGNH9r?domain=twitter.com) ,[Facebook](https://url.uk.m.mimecastprotect.com/s/AozDCR1JYSVrJERWFOsgI1Djme?domain=facebook.com) , and[Instagram](https://url.uk.m.mimecastprotect.com/s/KbKkCVQjpHvl735yTQtlIEPLLw?domain=instagram.com) .


**About Cutwater**


Cutwater, the most awarded canned cocktail brand in the U.S., is a San Diego-based distillery known for its lineup of 20+ canned cocktail classics made from its portfolio of bottled spirits that span nearly every spirits category. A key part of Anheuser-Busch's iconic line-up of brands, Cutwater operates from a 50,000-square-foot distillery and production facility, which includes a world-class tasting room and restaurant. To date, Cutwater has earned over 3,500 awards across its portfolio of products and is distributed in 50 states. Learn more at www.CutwaterSpirits.com or follow @cutwaterspirits on Instagram, X and Facebook.


**FAQs**


1. **Why is Anheuser-Busch making this investment?** Anheuser-Busch is investing $1.5 million in Cutwater's San Diego headquarters to expand cream-based cocktailproduction capacity, create manufacturing jobs and support the continued growth of America's #1 spirits-based cocktail brand. The project will help meet growing consumer demand while supporting future innovation.
2. **What will the investment fund?** The investment will expand cream-based cocktail production capabilities at Cutwater's flagship San Diego facility, which serves as the exclusive production location for the brand's cream liqueur portfolio. It will also support continued innovation and manufacturing growth at the site.
3. **Why is San Diego important to Cutwater?** San Diego is Cutwater's hometown and remains the heart of the brand. The brand’s headquarters, production facility, innovation center, tasting room and kitchen are all located in San Diego, where many of the brand's new products and seasonal innovations are developed.
4. **Will this create jobs?** Yes. The investment creates additional manufacturing jobs at Cutwater's San Diego facility, which currently employs more than 200 people.
5. **How is the Cutwater Tasting Room & Kitchen performing?** Consumer demand continues to grow both on and off premise. Over the past year, foot traffic at the Cutwater Tasting Room & Kitchen increased 29% and net revenue grew 36% compared to the prior year.
6. **How does this fit into Anheuser-Busch's broader investment strategy?** The San Diego project is part of more than $5 million in investments Anheuser-Busch has made to support Cutwater's growth, including previously announced projects in Los Angeles and Baldwinsville, New York. Together, these investments strengthen Cutwater's manufacturing footprint and support rising consumer demand nationwide.
7. **What role does Gingerbread White Russian play in the story?** The new limited-edition Gingerbread White Russian is one example of the innovation that the facility supports and helps bring to consumers nationwide.
